## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** Rebuild the hard-link mod tree and relaunch DATA/sys/main.dol; the generic session swap keep_state path applies as on GC, with no RE4-Wii-specific evidence and the same old-model-in-RAM caveat.

**Pick whip: none.** No RE4 Wii entity reader or profile; only pick_tool's generic wii RAM walk, which live-inject.md does not list for this title; the player pointer is not ported (P_PLAYER None).

**Live controls:** re_mods on RB4P08: unlock_all, merc_time_bonus, weapon_mod, merc_timer_freeze, unlimited_health; combo_time and grenade_safe refuse (not located); dispatcher ops not ported

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- Wii main.dol sha256 not pinned; re4_editions offsets are GC copies until relocated (locate() needs the Wii r13 for pG / player).
- Player pointer, ItemMgr and the per-frame hook are not ported (re_games.WII_PAL P_PLAYER / ITEM_MGR / HOOK_SITE None): no bot, no live give/equip/blasts.
- No RAM map file for RB4P08 in profiles/gamedata.
- Catalog says USA while the image is PAL RB4P08; a USA Wii revision is unmapped.
- Only the player swap is built; build_re4_enemies has no Wii branch (it builds a GC ISO image).
- No model pointer in RAM and no pick backend: any change is a rebuilt tree + relaunch.
- Parked: operator 2026-11-10 - Wii gets no new work.
